items.stem: Which TWO statements about SLAs and KPIs are correct? (Select TWO.)

options.text: An SLA states the service level that is promised
options.rationale: Correct: the SLA defines the committed standard.

options.text: A KPI measures whether the SLA is being met
options.rationale: Correct: KPIs quantify performance against the promise.

options.text: An SLA and a KPI are the same document
options.rationale: They are distinct: one is the promise, one is the measure.

options.text: KPIs should be set after the contract ends
options.rationale: KPIs must be defined up front to be useful.
